frames.quest: Find and photograph a single, fallen maple leaf displaying vibrant red hues.
frames.observation: A vibrant, orange-red maple leaf rests in a person’s hand, partially obscuring a blurred street scene.
frames.title: Autumn Maple Leaf
frames.field_note: The leaf’s coloration is remarkably intense, suggesting perhaps a particularly sunny autumn day or a specific cultivar of maple tree. Next time, I’ll be interested to observe the texture of the leaf’s veins – are they consistently fine, or do they vary with age?

frames.quest: Locate and capture the texture of rough bark on an ancient oak tree.
frames.observation: The photograph presents a close-up view of the deeply textured bark of a large oak tree, with a few autumn leaves clinging to its branches.
frames.title: Ancient Oak Bark
frames.field_note: The bark’s intricate patterns suggest this tree has weathered countless seasons, and I’d be keen to examine the growth rings more closely to estimate its age.  Next time, I’ll look for signs of lichen growth – it’s a fantastic indicator of a tree’s microclimate.

frames.quest: Photograph the dappled sunlight filtering through the branches above you.
frames.observation: The photo depicts a dense forest scene with tall trees and vibrant green foliage illuminated by dappled sunlight.
frames.title: Sun-Dappled Forest Interior
frames.field_note: The way the light plays through the leaves creates a truly magical effect, highlighting the textures of the bark and the forest floor. Next time, I’ll pay closer attention to the moss varieties growing on the tree trunks – there seems to be a lot of variation here.

frames.quest: Discover and document a tiny snail slowly navigating a damp stone.
frames.observation: A large, dark snail is moving slowly across a bed of damp stones and pebbles.
frames.title: Black Slug on Stone
frames.field_note: The snail’s deliberate movement is quite fascinating – it seems to be carefully selecting each stone as it travels. I'll be keen to observe what it's feeding on next time, as that could offer clues to its habitat and broader ecological role.

frames.quest: Find and photograph evidence of recent squirrel activity – a buried nut?
frames.observation: A grey squirrel is sitting on a patch of green grass, holding a small nut in its paws.
frames.title: Opportunistic Nut Retrieval
frames.field_note: The squirrel appears to be actively handling a nut, suggesting recent foraging behavior – a wonderful find! I’ll be keen to observe if it returns to this exact spot to bury its treasure.

frames.quest: Capture the shape of the clouds drifting across the autumn sky.
frames.observation: The photograph depicts a lone, mature tree with vibrant autumn foliage set against a clear blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds.
frames.title: Autumn Sky Silhouette
frames.field_note: The clouds are particularly dynamic here, creating a beautiful sense of movement. I’d like to revisit this spot during a period of stronger winds to see how the clouds interact with the tree’s branches more directly.
